name: NPN transistor (2N2222)
description: A small NPN transistor used as an electronic switch: a small current into the base (B) lets a bigger current flow from the collector (C) to the emitter (E). Connect E to GND, feed B from an Arduino pin through a 1kΩ resistor, and put the load (LED, buzzer, relay) between the supply and C. Switching model only: C and E connect when B is at least 0.6 V above E (no amplification).
